title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to [0.0, 0.0, -90.0] degrees and the translation vector set to [0.0, 0.0337, 0.0]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line begins at (0.75, 0.0) and extends to (0.75, 0.0337). The third line moves from (0.75, 0.0337) to (0.0, 0.0337), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by returning from (0.0, 0.0337) to the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, -90.0] degrees and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0337, 0.0]. Finally, extrude the transformed sketch 0.0337 units along its normal direction to create a solid body. The resulting shape is a long, slender, cylindrical form with a pointed tip at one end and a flat base at the other, resembling a stylized wand. The dimensions of this shape are 0.75 units in length, 0.0337 units in width, and 0.0337 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), -90).translate((0, 0.0337, 0))

# Create the sketch on the transformed workplane
sketch = (
    workplane
    .lineTo(0.75, 0)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0337)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0, 0.0337)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0, 0)  # line_4
    .close()  # Close the loop
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D shape
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0337)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0337) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0337) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.0337)
